description.value: Beach Fire Brewing Company is Campbell River's own craft brewery, producing award-winning beers including the High Tide Pale Ale (People's Choice at the Mount Washington Tapped Beer Festival) and the Ember Red Ale (Canada Beer Cup Gold in 2023 and 2025). The taproom backs its lineup with a full kitchen menu built entirely around locally sourced, in-house-prepared food — from snacks and shareables to hearty mains and decadent desserts. The brewery markets itself explicitly around community and the active West Coast lifestyle, with a trail-nodding house stout called WheelBender Stout.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and directly corroborates all OSM contact details (phone, address, website). The food menu page explicitly flags items with GF, V, and vegan labels, confirming dietary options; the beer menu page lists cans and refillable growlers, confirming takeout beer is available. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website text or OSM tags — 'WheelBender' is a beer name, not infrastructure evidence.
concerns: OSM opening hours (Tu-Th from 11:30, Su from 11:00) differ slightly from website (Tue-Thu from noon, Sun from noon); website values are likely more current.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, award-winning craft brewery with a full locally sourced kitchen menu and strong community focus in Campbell River; a genuine end-of-day destination for touring cyclists seeking a meal and craft beer.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Food menu labels items with GF (gluten-free) and V (vegetarian) icons throughout; Black Bean Tostadas explicitly noted as having a vegan option
